review_summary: Independent External Auditor evaluation confirms 100% compliance of 9702_w19_42 Question 11 across all 7 marks against primary Question Paper (pages 26-27) and official Mark Scheme (page 13). Part (a) accurately states Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction (induced e.m.f. proportional to rate of change of magnetic flux linkage) [2 marks: M1, A1]. Part (b)(i) correctly identifies zero induced e.m.f. at zero-gradient turning points of the current waveform (any two from t1, t3, t5, t7) [1 mark: A1]. Part (b)(ii) correctly identifies maximum induced e.m.f. of opposite polarities at maximum steepness points with opposite slopes (t2 & t4, or t4 & t6) [1 mark: A1]. Part (c) rigorously validates the calculation of average induced e.m.f. = 0.10 V upon reversing a 5.0 A current in 6.0 ms across 63 turns of diameter 3.6 cm [3 marks: 2 C1, 1 A1]. All leaves feature >=2 progressive non-giveaway hints, detailed teacher walkthroughs, correct checking modes (AI and hybrid with numeric tolerance [0.095, 0.105] V), response schema field bindings, verified 2025-2027 curriculum taxonomy bindings (Topic 20 Module 20.5, outcomes 9702_t20_m05_o04 and 9702_t20_m05_o05), skill 9702_skill_electromagnetic_induction_faraday_lenz, and exact marking-point parity with no findings.
